items.text: "Affordable" Depends on the Decision "Affordable" Depends on the Decision "Affordable" depends on the decision and the person's budget. A paid session is a real cost, so compare the published price with the value of resolving the specific choice in front of you rather than assuming that a higher fee means better guidance.

items.heading: "Package" Gets Used Loosely Across
items.text: "Package" gets used loosely across the market to mean anything from a single session to a vague multi-month bundle with unclear contents. If you have been searching for a career coaching package online, this is the same plan under a different name: continuous guidance across a year, with clear contents and one fixed price.
